title: Be supposed to: expectations and arrangements
meaningEn: Expectations, arrangements and norms, not guaranteed events
explanation: be supposed to可以说明安排、他人的预期或某种规则。The train was supposed to leave at nine说明原定九点发车，不保证它真的准点离开。You are not supposed to block the aisle表达规范上的不应做，不是说身体上做不到。使用时要结合上下文说明预期来自时刻表、通知还是某个人的理解。
usage: 区分计划或规则与实际发生的事，保留预期的信息来源。
nuance: was supposed to常用于解释安排未实现，但单凭结构仍不能断言一定失败。不要把supposed与表示猜测的I suppose简单等同。
structure: be not supposed to + base verb (a norm or expectation)
formation: be not supposed to + base verb (a norm or expectation)

examples.target: The train was supposed to leave at nine.
examples.zh: 这趟列车原定九点发车。

examples.target: We are supposed to meet on the platform.
examples.zh: 按安排，我们应在站台见面。

examples.target: You are not supposed to leave luggage in the aisle.
examples.zh: 按规定，不应把行李留在过道。

examples.target: The conductor was supposed to check our tickets before departure.
examples.zh: 按安排，列车员应在发车前检查我们的车票。

notes: 学习目标：区分计划或规则与实际发生的事，保留预期的信息来源。
等级是教学编排，不声称官方穷尽JLPT/CEFR清单。

commonMistakes.wrong: The train supposed to leave at nine.
commonMistakes.correct: The train was supposed to leave at nine.
commonMistakes.explanation: supposed前需要与主语和时间匹配的be；不能省略was。

comparison.explanation: supposed to着重预期或规范；allowed to着重是否获得许可。被允许并不表示一定会执行。

exercises.prompt: “The train was supposed to leave at nine.” 能确定什么？
options: 列车确实九点离开
列车原定九点离开
列车九点一定已到终点
acceptedAnswers: 列车原定九点离开
exercises.explanation: 结构报告安排，不提供实际发车时间的保证。

exercises.prompt: We（　）supposed to meet on the platform.
options: do
have
are
acceptedAnswers: are
exercises.explanation: 复数主语we在现在的安排中使用are supposed to。

exercises.prompt: 哪句正确表达“不应挡住过道”的规范？
options: You are not supposed to block the aisle.
You not supposed block the aisle.
You are not suppose blocking the aisle.
acceptedAnswers: You are not supposed to block the aisle.
exercises.explanation: 需要be、supposed及to加动词原形，否定放在be后。

exercises.prompt: 时刻表原定九点，但现在还不知道实际发车时间。哪句保留这个区别？
options: It definitely left at nine.
It was supposed to leave at nine.
It cannot ever leave after nine.
acceptedAnswers: It was supposed to leave at nine.
exercises.explanation: supposed to保留预期与实际之间的区别，不应替换成确定发生。

exercises.prompt: 参照例句，把“按安排，我们应在站台见面。”译成英语。
acceptedAnswers: We are supposed to meet on the platform.
We are supposed to meet on the platform
exercises.explanation: are supposed to说明约定，meet保持原形。

title: Be allowed to: permission, not ability
meaningEn: Permission granted by a person or rule
explanation: be allowed to加动词原形表示得到许可。Passengers are allowed to wait here说明此处允许等候，而不是说明旅客有等候的身体能力。过去式was allowed to可以说明某次获准的情况。否定was not allowed to是否定许可，不能与did not have to的“不必”混同。
usage: 阅读具体规则或描述获准行动，分清许可、能力和必要性。
nuance: 许可可能受地点、票种或时间限制。报告被允许，并不一定说明后来真的执行了；除非上下文另外明确。
structure: be not allowed to + base verb
was/were allowed to + base verb (past permission)
formation: be not allowed to + base verb
was/were allowed to + base verb (past permission)

examples.target: Passengers are allowed to wait in this room.
examples.zh: 旅客获准在这间屋里等候。

examples.target: We were allowed to use the earlier connection.
examples.zh: 我们获准乘坐更早的接驳班次。

examples.target: Passengers are not allowed to block the aisle with large suitcases.
examples.zh: 不允许乘客用大行李箱堵住过道。

examples.target: Was she allowed to transfer without another ticket?
examples.zh: 她当时获准不另买票就换乘吗？

notes: 学习目标：阅读具体规则或描述获准行动，分清许可、能力和必要性。
等级是教学编排，不声称官方穷尽JLPT/CEFR清单。

commonMistakes.wrong: We were allowed use the earlier connection.
commonMistakes.correct: We were allowed to use the earlier connection.
commonMistakes.explanation: allowed后需要to加动词原形；不能省略to。

comparison.explanation: 被要求或原定做与获准做不同；are supposed to meet不等于只是可以选择见面。
can可谈能力，也可在语境中谈许可；allowed to明确把焦点放在许可。

exercises.prompt: “We were allowed to use the earlier connection.” 直接说明什么？
options: 我们一定已坐上该班次
我们没有能力换乘
我们获得了使用该班次的许可
acceptedAnswers: 我们获得了使用该班次的许可
exercises.explanation: 句子本身报告许可，实际有没有乘坐还需更多信息。

exercises.prompt: Passengers are allowed（　）in this room.
options: to wait
wait
waiting
acceptedAnswers: to wait
exercises.explanation: be allowed to后使用动词原形wait。

exercises.prompt: 你想说明不许堵过道，而不是不必堵。应选哪句？
options: Passengers do not have to block the aisle.
Passengers are not allowed to block the aisle.
Passengers are unable to see an aisle.
acceptedAnswers: Passengers are not allowed to block the aisle.
exercises.explanation: not allowed明确禁止许可；do not have to只是说没有必要，意义不同。

exercises.prompt: 哪句保留正确过去许可结构？
options: We were allowed to transfer.
We were allow to transfer.
We allowed transferring by the notice.
acceptedAnswers: We were allowed to transfer.
exercises.explanation: 需要were allowed to加动词原形；其他选项没有正确构成该被动许可表达。

exercises.prompt: 参照例句，把“旅客获准在这间屋里等候。”译成英语。
acceptedAnswers: Passengers are allowed to wait in this room.
Passengers are allowed to wait in this room
exercises.explanation: are allowed to wait说明许可，并不声称人人都正在等候。

title: Had better: a specific warning or recommendation
meaningEn: Strong situational advice with an implied consequence
explanation: had better通常针对当前或即将发生的具体情况提出较强建议，并暗示不这样做可能有不利后果。We had better keep the test report强调这次应保留报告。虽然形式有had，意义通常不在过去。后面直接接不带to的动词原形，否定为had better not do。
usage: 提出有具体理由的当前建议，识别比一般should更强的语气。
nuance: had better有时听起来像警告或催促；不能当作任何场合都客气的建议。过去已经发生的错误通常另用should have等结构，本课不将两者混用。

examples.target: We had better keep the diagnostic report.
examples.zh: 我们最好保留诊断报告。

examples.target: You had better not install unverified firmware.
examples.zh: 你最好不要安装未经核验的固件。

examples.target: I had better ask which tests the retailer performed.
examples.zh: 我最好问清零售商做了哪些测试。

examples.target: We had better leave enough time for the return journey.
examples.zh: 我们最好给返程留出足够时间。

notes: 学习目标：提出有具体理由的当前建议，识别比一般should更强的语气。
等级是教学编排，不声称官方穷尽JLPT/CEFR清单。

commonMistakes.wrong: We had better to keep the report.
commonMistakes.correct: We had better keep the report.
commonMistakes.explanation: had better后直接接动词原形，不加to。

comparison.explanation: should适合一般建议；had better常针对具体情境暗示不做的后果，语气可能更强。
had better提出较强建议；may as well表示没有明显更好的替代，通常语气较轻。

exercises.prompt: “We had better keep the report.” 通常表达什么？
options: 只是陈述我们昨天保留过报告
针对当前情况较强地建议保留报告
禁止阅读任何报告
acceptedAnswers: 针对当前情况较强地建议保留报告
exercises.explanation: had是结构的一部分，不把建议自动放到过去。

exercises.prompt: You had better（　）unverified firmware.
options: not to install
not install
do not installing
acceptedAnswers: not install
exercises.explanation: 否定是had better not加动词原形，不能插入to。

exercises.prompt: 哪句正确提出当前建议？
options: I had better to ask first.
I had better asking first.
I had better ask first.
acceptedAnswers: I had better ask first.
exercises.explanation: had better后直接接ask，不接to或-ing。

exercises.prompt: 返程车次很少，不留时间可能赶不上。哪句最符合本课语气？
options: We had better leave enough time.
We left early yesterday.
We may have left earlier than usual.
acceptedAnswers: We had better leave enough time.
exercises.explanation: 当前具体风险支持较强的情境建议；其他两句描述过去，不是所需建议。

exercises.prompt: 参照例句，把“我们最好保留诊断报告。”译成英语。
acceptedAnswers: We had better keep the diagnostic report.
We’d better keep the diagnostic report.
We'd better keep the diagnostic report.
exercises.explanation: had better加keep原形；We’d是We had在该结构中的缩写。

title: May as well: no clearly better alternative
pattern: may / might as well + base verb
meaningEn: A practical option when alternatives offer little advantage
explanation: may as well或might as well加动词原形，常表示在当前选择中没有明显更好的办法，不如做某事。We may as well wait for the test result提出顺便等候，而不是推测“我们可能同样好”。它不保证行动最佳，也不同于may well表示很可能或有理由的判断。
usage: 基于当前替代方案提出务实选择，区分建议与概率推测。
nuance: 有时带一点无奈或接受现实的意味；也可以是轻松的顺便建议。不要把as well拆成和另一人一样好的比较。

examples.target: We may as well wait for the test result.
examples.zh: 我们不如等一等测试结果。

examples.target: The next train is much later, so we might as well have lunch here.
examples.zh: 下一班车晚很多，我们不如就在这里吃午饭。

examples.target: You may as well ask for a written explanation while you are here.
examples.zh: 既然你在这里，不如顺便要一份书面说明。

examples.target: I might as well check the return time now.
examples.zh: 我不如现在查一下返程时间。

notes: 学习目标：基于当前替代方案提出务实选择，区分建议与概率推测。
等级是教学编排，不声称官方穷尽JLPT/CEFR清单。

commonMistakes.wrong: We may as well to wait for the result.
commonMistakes.correct: We may as well wait for the result.
commonMistakes.explanation: may as well后接不带to的动词原形wait。

comparison.explanation: may as well着重当前没有更有利的替代；had better常强调不照做的潜在后果。
may well是有理由的可能性判断；may as well是务实选择，两者不能仅凭may相同就互换。

exercises.prompt: “We may as well wait for the result.” 最贴近什么？
options: 我们已经知道结果一定有利
我们比其他人等得更好
当前不如就等一下结果
acceptedAnswers: 当前不如就等一下结果
exercises.explanation: 结构提出一个在现有替代中务实的行动，不保证结果。

exercises.prompt: We might as well（　）the return time now.
options: check
to check
checking
acceptedAnswers: check
exercises.explanation: may/might as well后使用动词原形，不接to或-ing。

exercises.prompt: 下一班车很晚，附近又有餐馆。哪句是在提出务实选择？
options: We might have eaten before we arrived.
We might as well have lunch here.
We were supposed to bring our own lunch.
acceptedAnswers: We might as well have lunch here.
exercises.explanation: 缺少更有利的替代时，might as well自然提出就在此吃午饭。

exercises.prompt: 哪句正确使用本课结构？
options: I might as well ask now.
I might as well to ask now.
I might as well asking now.
acceptedAnswers: I might as well ask now.
exercises.explanation: ask是动词原形；另外两句错误加入to或-ing。

exercises.prompt: 参照例句，把“我不如现在查一下返程时间。”译成英语。
acceptedAnswers: I might as well check the return time now.
I may as well check the return time now.
exercises.explanation: may as well和might as well都可以提出这里的务实选择。
